generator.name: vasicek-lhp-simulator
generator.shaped_on: yearly default fractions of a large homogeneous portfolio with one systematic factor (dossier 04 C.4)

notice.en: Synthetic data: yearly default fractions of a large homogeneous portfolio drawn with a known asset correlation, not observations. Every estimate is shown beside the correlation it should recover.
notice.es: Datos sintéticos: fracciones anuales de incumplimiento de una cartera homogénea grande simuladas con una correlación de activos conocida, no observaciones. Cada estimación se muestra junto a la correlación que debe recuperar.

size_power_definition.en: Size is the rate at which H0 (the asset correlation equals the correlation under the null) is rejected when the known correlation is the correlation under the null; power is the same rate at any other known correlation. H0 is rejected when the correlation under the null lies outside the 95 % interval of the estimator.
size_power_definition.es: El tamaño es la tasa de rechazo de H0 (la correlación de activos es la correlación bajo la nula) cuando la correlación conocida es la correlación bajo la nula; la potencia es la misma tasa con otra correlación conocida. H0 se rechaza cuando la correlación bajo la nula queda fuera del intervalo al 95 % del estimador.

tests.h0: at the null correlation the rejection rate equals alpha (the size); elsewhere the rate is the power
tests.alternative: the rejection rate differs from alpha at the null correlation
tests.reference: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference, JASA 22(158):209-212; dossier 05 G.5 (validation tests of an economic capital model: check the allocation sums to the total, the sensitivity checks); dossier 04 C.4 (the Vasicek correlation) on a simulator with a known truth
